narrative.title: The Roster Chant Evolution
narrative.scenario: A marching band passes a count chant down the ranks. Each round, the cadet holding the chant reads it aloud as runs: how many of the same digit in a row, then the digit itself, run by run. Given the round number, the bandmaster needs the exact chant that round produces.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer n, the round index.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the chant string for round n under the run-length reading rule.

complexity.optimalTime: O(2^n) total output size (the string roughly doubles per round)

testCases.explanation: 1, 11, 21, 1211 — round 4 reads round 3's "21" as one-2 one-1.

hintLevels: Level 1: Scan the previous string in runs of equal digits; each run becomes count-then-digit.
Level 2: Build round by round from "1"; every round is a deterministic read of the last.
Level 3: Careful with the tail run — flush the pending run after the loop ends.
